project_context: SaaS Loyalty/Bonus Rewards Dashboard (B2B/B2C). Re-designing the BonusPage.js with premium aesthetics, removing the generic 'Бонусная программа' top pill, and adding sophisticated features like an out-of-stock label and a variant selection modal with live points total.

typography.headings: Manrope or Work Sans (Must not use Inter for headings). Apply `tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`.
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans, Figtree, or clean sans-serif.

colors.strategy: Dual-theme support matching strict requirements (Light: Teal, Dark: Orange). Never use pure black/white, tint with base hue.

layouts.page_container: max-w-4xl mx-auto py-12 px-4 sm:px-6 space-y-16
layouts.hero_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Left span-2 for Balance & Progress. Right span-1 for Current Level & Cashback info.
layouts.levels_track: flex items-center justify-between relative w-full mt-8

components.hero_points: Massive text for points, left aligned. '12,450' in `text-6xl font-black`. Subtitle 'Доступно баллов'.
components.progress_bar: Thick pill-shaped track `h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10`. Inner fill is `h-full rounded-full bg-teal-600 dark:bg-orange-500`. Use Framer Motion to animate `width` from 0%.
components.levels_visualization:
Horizontal line connecting circular nodes. 
- Completed: Solid background, check icon.
- Current: Accent background, pulsing outer ring (`animate-pulse` or motion ring).
- Locked: Muted background, smaller icon. Text placed below nodes.
components.prize_card:
Cardless or subtle 1px border style. `rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300`. 
- Image section: `h-48` with `object-cover`.
- Content: generous padding `p-6`.
- Redeem button: Full width, bold.
components.out_of_stock_treatment: If `quantity === 0` -> Apply `grayscale opacity-60` to the image. Show an absolute positioned badge at top-right 'ЗАКОНЧИЛСЯ'. Disable the redeem button and change text to 'Нет в наличии'.
components.variant_selection_modal:
Shadcn Dialog or Framer Motion overlay. 
- Content: Grid of selectable pills for Color, Memory, etc. 
- Pills: `border rounded-lg px-4 py-2 cursor-pointer`. Active state gets solid border + light accent bg.
- Live Total: Sticky bottom bar showing base cost + options cost. Animates when number changes.

motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for sections. `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}`.
motion.progress_fill: Spring animation for width. `transition={{ type: 'spring', bounce: 0.2, duration: 1.5 }}`.
motion.prize_cards: Stagger children in grid. `variants={{ hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }}`.
motion.number_counter: When variant is selected, points total should ideally scale slightly or use a quick spring up/down to draw attention.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure teal-600 against slate-50 and orange-500 against #0A0A0A meet WCAG 4.5:1. Use Text Shadow on hero if needed.
accessibility.interactive: Include `data-testid` on all buttons, nodes, and variant pills (e.g., `data-testid='redeem-prize-button'`, `data-testid='variant-color-red'`).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for the confetti and progress bar.

smartphone.description: Premium smartphone display, use for tech prizes

instructions_to_main_agent: Remove the top 'Бонусная программа' pill entirely.
Refactor BonusPage.js to use the High Density Bento grid for the top stats.
Implement dual-theme using standard Tailwind `dark:` classes.
Add 'Закончился' label functionality to prize card items with 0 stock.
Create a new modal component for Variant Selection (Color, Memory) that calculates the live point cost.
Ensure the progress bar animates gracefully on mount using Framer Motion.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>`, use modern pill-buttons for variant choices in the modal.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align the app container. Align left for readability.
Add transitions exclusively for interactive states (hover, focus), avoid `transition-all` where it breaks transforms.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) to ensure premium feel.
Never use generic placeholder images, use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Ensure all components are strictly written in .js files since the project uses JS.
